question: Is the FY26 alumina and LME aluminium price realization guidance (management's own directional calls) consistent with independent commodity price trackers/analyst consensus for CY2025-2026, or is management's price narrative systematically lagging/leading the actual market?
rationale: Ledger shows alumina price guide ratcheted down every quarter and LME CY2026 guide swung 17% in one quarter; need an external anchor (e.g., independent alumina index, LME futures curve at each guidance date) to determine whether NALCO's guidance lags spot or is genuinely predictive.

question: What is the current (as of the most recent public disclosure) status of the Pottangi bauxite mine MDO tender and physical commissioning — has it commissioned by the guided May/June 2026 window, and which of the two conflicting dates (May per PPT, June per transcript) proved correct?
rationale: Internal transcript-vs-PPT date mismatch (F-GUI-05) combined with a late MDO tender as of Nov-2025 for a claimed May-2026 start; no FY2027Q1 transcript exists yet in the input set to confirm actual commissioning.

question: Has the 5th-stream alumina refinery actually commenced commissioning in June 2026 as guided (post-reset date), or has this asset slipped for a second time?
rationale: This is the single largest capacity-growth catalyst in the company's near-term story and already carries one admitted slip (implied Sept-2025 to June-2026) plus one in-year volume-guidance cut (500KT to 300KT, F-GUI-01). A second slip would materially impair FY27 volume/margin estimates. Next data point: Q1 FY27 transcript (expected ~Aug-2026), not yet in the input set as of this run.

rationale: FY2026 AR not yet published per intake manifest gap; cash balance guide (GD-Q2-012) cannot be scored for delivery until the FY26 annual accounts or a subsequent quarter's balance sheet disclosure is available.

question: What is management's actual (not company-claimed) track record on capacity-expansion timelines prior to FY2026 — i.e., did NALCO's brownfield/greenfield projects in FY2021-FY2025 (pre-transcript period) slip similarly, or is the FY26 5th-stream/smelter/Pottangi pattern a new development?
rationale: No transcripts exist for FY2021-FY2025 (per manifest gap), so the credibility scores in this ledger are built on a single fiscal year of management commentary.
